states.description: Person wakes up, uses phone, gets out of bed, turns on light, opens curtains, and leaves the bedroom.

triggers: Person is heading to the curtains.
Person has walked up to the window.

next.on: Person has returned to the room.

states.description: Person returns to the room, dries hair, dresses, and makes the bed.

next.on: Person is heading into the kitchen.

states.description: Person prepares and eats breakfast at the dining table.

triggers: Person is seated at the dining table, looking ahead idly, with an empty bowl and an empty cup sitting on the table.
Person is using a smartphone, with an empty bowl and an empty cup sitting on the table.
rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.

triggers: Person is seated at the dining table, looking ahead idly, with an empty bowl and an empty cup sitting on the table.
Person is using a smartphone, with an empty bowl and an empty cup sitting on the table.
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it in the dishwasher.

next.on: Person is bringing a can of coffee to the sofa.

states.description: Person sits on the sofa, drinks coffee, watches TV, and takes a phone call.

triggers: Person has finished the coffee and set the empty can down.
Person is switching the TV off.
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it in the designated storage area.

next.on: Person is heading to the desk.

states.description: Person packs bag, puts on jacket, turns off lights, and leaves the home.

triggers: Person is slinging the bag over their shoulder.
Person is heading toward the wall switch by the door.
Person is putting on a backpack.
